changeSet.author: nexus-hczdo.1.1
changeSet.comment: nexus.identity_work (RDR-253): the background work an identity owns, permanent until its identity is tombstoned. References identity_records ON DELETE CASCADE. Tenant-scoped, RLS ENABLE+FORCE.
changeSet.sql:
CREATE TABLE nexus.identity_work ( tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, identity_id TEXT NOT NULL, kind TEXT NOT NULL, ref TEXT NOT NULL, state TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL, CONSTRAINT identity_work_pk PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, identity_id, kind, ref), CONSTRAINT identity_work_identity_fk FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, identity_id) REFERENCES nexus.identity_records (tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE, CONSTRAINT identity_work_kind_ck CHECK (kind IN ('watcher', 'wait', 'labrun', 'worktree', 'tmux')), CONSTRAINT identity_work_state_ck CHECK (state IN ('running', 'done')) );
ALTER TABLE nexus.identity_work ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; ALTER TABLE nexus.identity_work FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY; CREATE POLICY tenant_isolation ON nexus.identity_work USING (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true)) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = current_setting('nexus.tenant', true));
changeSet.rollback: DROP TABLE IF EXISTS nexus.identity_work CASCADE
